run_train_cpa: train a CPA autoencoder model using command-line arguments for drug perturbation data
run_evaluate: evaluate a trained CPA autoencoder on training, test, and out-of-distribution dataset splits
run_evaluate_r2: measure R2 score quality metrics for a CPA autoencoder on gene expression predictions
run_evaluate_disentanglement: measure latent space disentanglement between drug vectors and covariate vectors in a CPA model
run_parse_arguments: parse command-line arguments for data path, model hyperparameters, and training configuration
